Method of Attack: Malicious browser extension to steal emails from Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge users reading their webmail
Steals mail from Gmail and AOL accounts
Installs after compromising target system using custom VBS script replacing 'Preferences' and 'Secure Preferences' files with ones from command-and-control server
Exfiltrates data directly from victim's webmail account during browsing
Uses commands to list collected emails, email domains, blacklist senders, add viewed domains, upload attachments and Gmail/AOL data
Takes advantage of already-logged-in sessions to avoid detection
Does not trigger suspicious activity alerts on victim's email accounts
Attack Vector: Malicious browser extension installed via compromised system using custom VBS script
